failed_jobs.reason: StartAsync_DashboardAuthConfig_PassedToDashboardProcess fails with a TaskCanceledException during DistributedApplication.StopAsync, in code unrelated to the PR's extension-only changes (CONTRIBUTING.md, run-e2e.js, winUiDebug.e2e.test.ts, e2eLaunchProfile.test.ts). Matches a known recurring flaky shutdown-timeout pattern.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: The 'after each' teardown hook for the dynamic debug configuration E2E test fails with EBUSY (resource busy or locked) when removing a Windows temp workspace directory. This is a known Windows file-locking race condition in test teardown, unrelated to the PR's changes.
